title: Engineer. Singer. Mobile gamer.
paragraphs: I also keep myself unusually up to date. Reddit, TLDR, engineering discussions, product chatter, release notes, and AI tooling shifts are part of how I track a tech world that changes faster than most advice can keep up with.

Outside work, I play Mobile Legends: Bang Bang, a mobile team strategy battle game, at Mythic rank with 2000+ expertise. I mostly play Beatrix, which is very on-brand: positioning, timing, fast reads, and committing only when the angle is right.

values.title: Full-circle ownership
values.description: UX, logic, data flow, performance, documentation, and polish all have to make sense before something ships.

values.title: Structure and soul
values.description: Code with logic. Design with emotion. Both matter. That is what creates real connection between a product and a person.

values.title: Clarity over complexity
values.description: If it needs a paragraph to explain, it needs a redesign. Interfaces and code that make sense at a glance.

values.title: Security from line one
values.description: Input validation, RBAC, rate limits, and permission boundaries belong in the design, not in cleanup.
